<script>
  const registrationForm = document.getElementById('solar-registration-form');
  const registrationStatus = document.getElementById('registration-status');
  const startCourseLink = document.getElementById('start-course-link');
  const registrationServiceUrl = 'https://form.tally.so/r/REPLACE_WITH_FORM_ID';
  const isConfigured = registrationServiceUrl && !registrationServiceUrl.includes('REPLACE_WITH_FORM_ID');

  if (registrationForm) {
    registrationForm.addEventListener('submit', async function (event) {
      event.preventDefault();

      if (!registrationForm.checkValidity()) {
        registrationForm.reportValidity();
        return;
      }

      const payload = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(registrationForm).entries());
      registrationStatus.textContent = 'Submitting your registration...';

      if (!isConfigured) {
        const key = 'spotted-ape-solar-registration';
        try {
          const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || '[]');
          stored.push({
            ...payload,
            privacyAccepted: payload.privacyAccepted === 'on',
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
          });
          localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(stored));
        } catch (storageError) {
          console.warn('Unable to save local registration preview.', storageError);
        }

        registrationStatus.textContent = 'The registration service has not been configured yet. This page is ready for live submission once the owner adds the Tally form URL. The current browser record has been saved locally for review.';
        startCourseLink.hidden = false;
        registrationForm.reset();
        return;
      }

      try {
        const response = await fetch(registrationServiceUrl, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error('Registration submission failed');
        }

        registrationStatus.textContent = 'Registration received. You can now start the learning activity.';
        startCourseLink.hidden = false;
        registrationForm.reset();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        registrationStatus.textContent = 'The live registration service is unavailable right now. Please contact the site owner to complete registration or recheck the configured service.';
      }
    });
  }
</script>
